day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's complimentary Magical Express shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25–35) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack, and get a good night's rest to prepare for the days ahead.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a quick snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a light late-night snack from the resort's convenience store or vending machines upon arrival — save receipts for budgeting

day_by_day.notes: Keep arrival simple. Download the My Disney Experience app tonight if not already done. Link your park tickets and make any last-minute dining reservations. Lay out comfortable walking shoes and sunscreen for tomorrow. The resort may have a 24-hour front desk — confirm your room details and ask about any free resort perks.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom Park — the most iconic Disney park. Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Prioritize high-demand rides first: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Space Mountain, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use Disney's free Lightning Lane planning tools in the app to manage wait times efficiently.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Fantasyland attractions like Peter Pan's Flight and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy parade (check the app for timing). Take a mid-afternoon break in the shade near Liberty Square to rest your feet and rehydrate — bring a refillable water bottle to save money.
day_by_day.evening: Stay in Magic Kingdom for the spectacular nighttime show — Disney Enchantment fireworks display over Cinderella Castle (check schedule). Find a good viewing spot near Main Street USA at least 45 minutes early. Head back to the resort via Disney's free bus transportation after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before heading out — grab grab-and-go items from the resort food court to save money
meals.lunch: Casey's Corner on Main Street USA (hot dogs and corn dog nuggets, ~$10–14 per person) — one of the most budget-friendly quick-service spots in Magic Kingdom
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — large portions, budget-friendly quick-service with burgers, chicken, and salads (~$12–16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase a refillable Disney resort mug (~$22) if staying on-site — it pays for itself quickly. Wear light, breathable clothing as June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Apply sunscreen every 2 hours. Pack a small backpack with snacks from a grocery store to avoid expensive in-park snack costs.

day_by_day.morning: Visit EPCOT — Disney's most adult-friendly and culturally rich park. Arrive at rope drop and head straight to Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required — set an alarm for 7:00 AM to grab a virtual queue spot via the app). Then hit Test Track and Soarin' Around the World.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase — a walkable loop featuring 11 country pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, USA, Japan, Morocco, France, UK, Canada). Each pavilion offers free cultural entertainment, street performers, and architecture to explore. Visit the Norway pavilion for the Frozen Ever After ride. Browse artisan crafts and cultural exhibits at no extra cost.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular — EPCOT Forever or HarmonioUS (check current schedule on the app). Watch from the World Showcase lagoon for the best views. Return to resort via Disney's free bus service.

meals.breakfast: Pack snacks and a light breakfast from the resort food court before heading out
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best budget quick-service spots with fresh, healthy options (~$12–15 per person)
meals.dinner: Lotus Blossom Café in the China Pavilion — affordable quick-service with egg rolls, fried rice, and noodle bowls (~$11–15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park — comfortable shoes are essential. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan Future World (front of park) attractions for the morning. Free water is available at any quick-service counter — just ask. Download park maps offline in case of spotty WiFi.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Disney's Hollywood Studios — home to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge and Toy Story Land. Arrive at rope drop and immediately head to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Both are extremely popular — early arrival is essential.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then head to Sunset Boulevard for The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Check the app for Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show times — it's a free, entertaining live show included with park admission.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check schedule — usually 8:00 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 30–45 minutes early for good seats. This is a free, included spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse, water screens, and fireworks. Head back to resort afterward.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort food court before heading to the park — oatmeal, yogurt, or grab-and-go items
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — beloved quick-service with grilled cheese sandwiches, totchos, and lemonade (~$10–14 per person)
meals.dinner: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — unique theming with affordable quick-service options like Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken) and Ronto Wraps (~$13–17 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios tends to have some of the longest wait times at Disney World. Use the My Disney Experience app's wait time tracker constantly. Consider purchasing one Lightning Lane Multi Pass selection for Rise of the Resistance if budget allows (~$15–25 per person) to save significant time. Bring your own water and snacks.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Disney's Animal Kingdom — Disney's largest park by area. Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora – The World of Avatar (the most in-demand ride at Animal Kingdom). Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby. The early morning light in Pandora is breathtaking.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom — ride Expedition Everest in Asia and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — a fun way to cool off in June heat). Visit the Kilimanjaro Safaris in Africa for a free-roaming animal experience included with admission. Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for up-close animal encounters.
day_by_day.evening: Watch Rivers of Light or the Tree of Life Awakenings nighttime show (check current schedule). The Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal imagery after dark — a magical, free-included experience. Head back to the resort and consider a relaxing swim at the resort pool to unwind.

meals.breakfast: Pack breakfast from the resort or grab a quick bite at the resort food court
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of Disney World's best quick-service restaurants with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with beautiful waterfront seating (~$13–17 per person)
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — healthy, customizable bowls with grains, proteins, and sauces at reasonable Disney prices (~$13–16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active. Bring a light poncho for Kali River Rapids or prepare to get soaked. The park often closes earlier than other Disney parks — check hours in advance. June heat can be intense — plan a mid-afternoon resort break if energy levels drop.

day_by_day.morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning — sleep in and enjoy the resort amenities. Take a dip in the Aegean Bliss Resort pool, relax on the beachfront area, and recharge. Use this time to do a quick grocery run to a nearby Walmart or Publix via rideshare (~$10–15 round trip) to stock up on snacks, water bottles, and easy breakfast items to save money for the remaining days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney Springs — Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required). Explore unique shops, street performers, and entertainment. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and browse the eclectic mix of boutiques. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 if desired (~$15 per person).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner and live entertainment at Disney Springs. Stroll the waterfront promenade, watch free live music performances at the stages throughout the district, and browse the evening atmosphere. Return to the resort via Disney's free bus service from Disney Springs.

meals.breakfast: Resort food court or groceries purchased — make your own simple breakfast to save significantly
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort pool bar or packed snacks from your grocery run
meals.dinner: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs — award-winning craft BBQ with smoked meats, creative sides, and cocktails at reasonable prices (~$15–20 per person). Or D-Luxe Burger for a more budget-friendly option (~$12–15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and park (self-parking is also free). This is a great day to do laundry if needed, rest sore feet, and plan your final park day strategy. Check the My Disney Experience app for any special events or entertainment schedules happening this evening at Disney Springs.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for one final magical day — or revisit Magic Kingdom for anything you missed on Day 2. Alternatively, use this day to explore any park you feel deserves a second visit based on the week's experiences. Arrive at rope drop one last time and prioritize any must-do rides or experiences you haven't yet experienced.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend your final afternoon soaking in the Disney magic. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs — note that the best budget souvenir shopping is at Disney Springs (wider selection, slightly lower prices) or the resort gift shop. Visit any remaining attractions and take photos at iconic spots: Cinderella Castle, the Tree of Life, Spaceship Earth, or the Hollywood Tower.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final Disney dinner and watch one last nighttime spectacular. Pack bags back at the resort, do a final check of all belongings, and prepare for checkout. Set an early alarm if departing the next morning. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic on a budget!

meals.breakfast: Use up remaining grocery items or resort food court — keep it light and affordable
meals.lunch: Quick-service meal in whichever park you visit — budget ~$12–15 per person
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly on your final night — consider a table-service restaurant like Be Our Guest (Magic Kingdom) if budget allows, or keep it budget-friendly with a favorite quick-service spot from the week (~$15–20 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Check resort checkout time (typically 11:00 AM). Disney's Luggage Storage service allows you to store bags at the resort after checkout so you can continue enjoying the parks on your final day without hauling luggage. Budget recap tip: A family of 4 can experience Disney World on a budget by packing snacks (~$50/week in groceries), using Disney's free transportation, and sticking to quick-service dining — saving hundreds compared to table-service meals and paid transportation.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit
day_by_day.evening: Late arrival at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and settle into your Beachfront room. Grab a light snack from the resort's lobby convenience store or 24-hour vending area.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Light late-night snack from resort convenience store or a quick-service option if the resort has a 24-hour eatery (e.g., a sandwich or packaged snack). Budget ~$10–$15 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 extremely light. Do not book any park tickets for this day. Hydrate well, set alarms for an early start on Day 2, and review your Disney app to confirm park reservations. Florida in June is hot and humid, so pack sunscreen and light clothing.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Start Early! Arrive at Magic Kingdom at rope drop (typically 8:00–9:00 AM). Hit the high-demand rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically for top-tier attractions. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland before crowds build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue your Magic Kingdom adventure through the afternoon. Experience Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Splash Mountain. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (usually around 3:00 PM). Take a mid-afternoon break at a shaded area or air-conditioned shop to escape the peak heat (typically 1:00–3:00 PM in June).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the iconic Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular – Disney Enchantment fireworks show (typically around 9:00 PM). Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. 30 minutes early. Exit the park after the show and return to Aegean Bliss Resort via Disney transportation.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort before heading out – buffet or grab-and-go. Budget ~$15–$20 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House (Liberty Square) – excellent quick-service option with clam chowder, fish & chips, and lobster rolls. Budget ~$15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Fantasyland) – mid-range table service inside the Beast's Castle. Book via Disney app in advance. Budget ~$35–$55 per person. Alternatively, try Skipper Canteen for a fun, affordable table-service experience.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance via the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring a portable fan or cooling towel. June temperatures can reach 90°F+ with high humidity. Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Arrive at EPCOT at opening (typically 9:00 AM). Begin in Future World / World Discovery and ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines grow. Then transition to World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring EPCOT's World Showcase. Sample authentic cuisines and snacks from pavilions including Japan (sushi, mochi), France (crepes, macarons), Mexico (tacos, margaritas), and Morocco (shawarma). Ride Frozen Ever After in Norway and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in France. Enjoy cultural performances and artisan demonstrations throughout the pavilions.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular – EPCOT Forever or Harmonious (check current show schedule). Watch from the World Showcase Lagoon with a drink in hand. Afterward, head back to Aegean Bliss Resort for a relaxing evening by the beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort or a pastry from the France Pavilion Boulangerie once inside EPCOT. Budget ~$10–$15 per person.
meals.lunch: World Showcase grazing lunch – sample 3–4 small dishes across different country pavilions. Budget ~$25–$35 per person total.
meals.dinner: Coral Reef Restaurant (EPCOT, near The Seas pavilion) – mid-range table-service seafood dining with an aquarium view. Budget ~$35–$50 per person. Book in advance via My Disney Experience app.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is best experienced leisurely. Don't try to rush through every pavilion – pick 6–7 favorites. The Food & Wine or Flower & Garden Festival may be running in June, offering additional food booths and entertainment. Check the Disney website for current seasonal events.

day_by_day.morning: Rest & Resort Morning – After two full park days, take a relaxed morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy the beachfront amenities, pool, or a leisurely breakfast. Sleep in until 8:00–9:00 AM and recharge. This is a great time to review the rest of the week's plans and make any dining reservations you may have missed.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Afternoon – Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required) around noon. Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Town Center, Marketplace, and West Side. Visit World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), browse unique shops, and enjoy live entertainment from street performers. Check out the LEGO Store, NBA Experience, or Splitsville Luxury Lanes for family fun.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Evening Entertainment – Enjoy live music at the outdoor stages, catch a movie at AMC Disney Springs 24 (great air-conditioned option), or experience a dinner show. Stroll along the waterfront and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort breakfast – sit-down meal at the resort restaurant. Budget ~$18–$25 per person.
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza or D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – casual, affordable, and delicious. Budget ~$15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – upscale-casual waterfront dining with steaks, seafood, and amphicars. Mid-range splurge night. Budget ~$40–$60 per person. Alternatively, try Rainforest Cafe for a family-friendly themed dining experience at ~$25–$40 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is a great no-ticket day option. Parking is free in the garages. If driving from the resort, arrive early as parking fills quickly in the afternoon. This day is intentionally lighter to prevent park fatigue and keep the family energized for the remaining days.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Arrive at park opening (typically 8:00–9:00 AM). Head directly to Galaxy's Edge (Batuu) and join the virtual queue or purchase Individual Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance – one of the most immersive theme park experiences ever created. Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue at Hollywood Studios with more iconic attractions. Visit Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania), experience the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. If time permits, visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (reservation required, ~$249.99 per lightsaber – optional premium add-on) or the Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$119.99).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Hollywood Studios nighttime shows – Fantasmic! (check showtimes, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM) featuring Mickey Mouse in a spectacular water, fire, and projection show. Grab a reserved dining package for guaranteed Fantasmic! seating if available. Return to the resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Early grab-and-go breakfast at the resort before rope drop. Budget ~$10–$15 per person.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge) – themed Star Wars quick-service with unique menu items like Ronto Wraps and Felucian Garden Spread. Budget ~$15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café (Hollywood Studios) – fun retro diner atmosphere with classic American comfort food. Mid-range table service. Budget ~$25–$40 per person. Book in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Galaxy's Edge is extremely popular – arrive early or use Lightning Lane. The lightsaber and droid building experiences require advance reservations made via the My Disney Experience app and sell out weeks in advance. Check availability before your trip. Fantasmic! seating fills up fast – arrive 45–60 minutes early for the best spots.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom – Safari & Avatar Experience – Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop (typically 8:00 AM). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the most popular ride in the park – lines can exceed 2 hours). Use Lightning Lane if available. Then experience Na'vi River Journey for a calmer, beautiful boat ride through bioluminescent rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon for active animals). See real African wildlife including lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and hippos up close. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for walking wildlife encounters. Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride and family-friendly carnival games. Catch a performance of Finding Nemo: The Big Blue… and Beyond! at the Theater in the Wild.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular at Animal Kingdom (check if currently running – schedule varies). Alternatively, if the park closes early (Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks), head back to Aegean Bliss Resort for a relaxing beachfront evening – enjoy the sunset, pool, or a resort activity. This is a great night to decompress before your final full park day.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go at the resort or Zuri's Swampy Snacks inside Animal Kingdom. Budget ~$10–$15 per person.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora) – one of the best quick-service restaurants in all of Disney World with healthy, flavorful bowls and unique beverages. Budget ~$15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant (Asia section, Animal Kingdom) – mid-range Asian-fusion table service in a beautifully themed setting. Budget ~$25–$40 per person. Book in advance. Alternatively, enjoy a relaxed dinner at the resort restaurant.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. The park often closes earlier than other Disney parks (sometimes 8:00–9:00 PM), so plan accordingly. Wear extra sunscreen as the park has large open areas with intense Florida sun. Bug spray is also recommended near the trails and safari areas.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning – Resort Leisure & Farewell Activities. Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed breakfast at the resort. Take one last walk along the beachfront of Aegean Bliss Resort and enjoy the amenities you may not have had time for during the busy park days. Pack souvenirs and begin organizing luggage. If you have a late checkout, take advantage of the pool or beach one final time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Optional Half-Day Return to a Favorite Park or Disney Springs. If energy permits and you have park tickets, return to your favorite park for a few hours in the morning/early afternoon to catch any missed attractions. Alternatively, do a final Disney Springs shopping trip to pick up last-minute souvenirs, specialty foods, and gifts. World of Disney and the Marketplace are perfect for souvenir shopping within a mid-range budget.
day_by_day.evening: Resort Farewell Dinner & Departure Prep. Enjoy a special farewell dinner at the resort restaurant or a nearby Orlando dining option. Begin final packing and prepare for checkout. Confirm transportation to the airport for your departure. Reflect on an incredible week at Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast – treat yourself to a full sit-down meal. Budget ~$20–$28 per person.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at Disney Springs or resort pool bar. Budget ~$15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's signature restaurant or a nearby mid-range Orlando restaurant such as Bosphorous Turkish Cuisine or a local favorite on International Drive. Budget ~$30–$50 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Check resort checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) and arrange luggage storage if needed for a later departure. Confirm your return flight details and allow extra travel time from Disney World to Orlando International Airport (typically 30–45 minutes by rideshare or shuttle). Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare service can be pre-booked for airport transfers. Don't forget to check all rooms for forgotten items and return any rental equipment.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy in-flight dining or grab a light bite at the airport upon arrival
meals.lunch: In-flight or airport dining
meals.dinner: Late-night room service at Aegean Bliss Resort — order a curated charcuterie board, gourmet sandwiches, and premium beverages from the 24-hour luxury in-room dining menu to unwind after travel

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange private airport transfer before departure. Confirm resort check-in details in advance as arrival is after 10 PM. Request early access to resort amenities and park tickets to be ready at the concierge desk upon arrival. Set up Disney MagicBand+ wristbands and link all park reservations via the My Disney Experience app tonight before sleeping.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely resort morning. Take advantage of the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront amenities — a sunrise stroll along the waterfront, a dip in the luxury pool, or a rejuvenating spa treatment at the resort spa. This is a deliberate recovery day after late-night travel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs (complimentary resort shuttle available) for an afternoon of world-class shopping, exploration, and entertainment. Browse premium boutiques including the massive World of Disney store, UNIQLO, and luxury brand shops. Visit the LEGO Store and pick up exclusive Disney-themed collectibles. Explore the artisan marketplace and enjoy the lakeside atmosphere.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening — Experience live entertainment at the House of Blues or Splitsville Luxury Lanes. Enjoy the vibrant waterfront atmosphere with street performers, live music stages, and dazzling lights reflecting off the lake.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature waterfront restaurant — eggs Benedict, smoked salmon platters, fresh tropical fruits, and premium coffee or mimosas
meals.lunch: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Pan-Asian restaurant offering exquisite dim sum, sushi, and signature Asian fusion dishes in an elegant setting
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — upscale modern steakhouse with USDA prime cuts, creative cocktails, and a vibrant atmosphere; reserve the chef's table or private dining room for a premium experience

day_by_day.notes: Make dining reservations at Morimoto Asia and STK well in advance (60+ days) via OpenTable or Disney's dining reservation system. Disney Springs is free admission — no park ticket required. This lighter day allows the family to acclimate to Orlando before full park days begin. Pick up any forgotten essentials at Disney Springs' pharmacies or specialty shops.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM) using Early Theme Park Entry benefit (available to Disney resort guests, allowing entry 30 minutes before official opening). Begin with Tomorrowland: ride Space Mountain and TRON Lightcycle / Run before crowds build. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass (pre-purchased) to skip standby lines. Move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — experience Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically 3:00 PM) from a premium reserved viewing spot. Visit Liberty Square and Frontierland. Take a mid-afternoon break in an air-conditioned restaurant to recharge during peak heat hours (1–3 PM).
day_by_day.evening: Position your family for the best views of the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (typically 9:00 PM). Pre-book the Disney Enchanting Extras fireworks dessert party at Tomorrowland Terrace for exclusive reserved viewing with unlimited premium desserts and beverages. Exit the park after fireworks via resort's private shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant — breakfast inside the Beast's enchanted castle in Fantasyland; a magical, immersive dining experience with French-inspired breakfast items (reserve 60 days in advance)
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Skipper Canteen — Skipper Canteen offers a unique themed experience with globally-inspired cuisine in an adventurous setting inside Magic Kingdom
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table — dine inside Cinderella Castle itself for a premium prix-fixe dinner with character meet-and-greets including Cinderella and Disney Princesses; one of Disney's most exclusive dining reservations

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and individual Lightning Lane selections for top-tier attractions (TRON, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train) at 7:00 AM on the day of visit via the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable walking shoes and apply sunscreen — June temperatures in Orlando can reach 90°F+ with high humidity. Bring refillable water bottles; free ice water is available at any quick-service location. The Enchanting Extras fireworks dessert party must be booked separately through Disney's website.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-18 (Thursday) — EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT using Early Theme Park Entry. Begin in Future World / World Discovery area: experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Lightning Lane Individual required) and Test Track. Visit World Nature pavilions including The Seas with Nemo & Friends and Soarin' Around the World for a breathtaking aerial journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin the World Showcase exploration as it opens at 11:00 AM. Stroll the 1.2-mile promenade around World Showcase Lagoon visiting all 11 country pavilions — Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic cuisine and snacks at each pavilion. Meet Disney characters in their themed countries (Frozen characters in Norway, Remy in France). Explore artisan galleries, cultural exhibits, and unique merchandise in each pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the World Showcase tour with premium dinner in France or Japan pavilion, then secure a prime spot for EPCOT's spectacular nighttime lagoon show — 'Luminous: The Symphony of Us' — featuring dazzling fireworks, water projections, and synchronized music. Alternatively, book the EPCOT IllumiNations or Harmonious dessert party for reserved lakeside viewing.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons at The Land Pavilion — a fresh, healthy quick-service breakfast with seasonal offerings, or grab a pastry and coffee at Connections Café
meals.lunch: Progressive World Showcase Lunch — graze through multiple pavilions: Kringla Bakeri og Kafé (Norway) for school bread and salmon, La Cantina de San Angel (Mexico) for tacos, and Tokyo Dining (Japan) for sushi and tempura
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul — EPCOT's most upscale dining experience located above the France pavilion; a refined French restaurant with an award-winning menu, extensive wine list, and views of the World Showcase lagoon; prix-fixe menu available

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is a food lover's paradise — budget extra for snacking between pavilions as part of the cultural experience. The EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival (typically August–November) is not active in June, but the pavilion restaurants are always available. Book Monsieur Paul 60 days in advance — it is one of Disney's most sought-after reservations. Comfortable walking shoes are essential for the full World Showcase loop.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-19 (Friday) — Hollywood Studios: Star Wars Galaxy's Edge & More
day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive using Early Theme Park Entry and head directly to Galaxy's Edge (land of Batuu). Book the first available slot at Savi's Workshop to build a custom handcrafted lightsaber (approximately $299 per saber; reservations required and sell out quickly). This intimate, theatrical 20-minute experience is led by Gatherers and is a highlight for all ages. Immediately follow with Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of Disney's most technically impressive attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Galaxy's Edge — pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, shop for droid parts at the Droid Depot (build your own custom droid, ~$119), and browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for rare collectibles. Exit Galaxy's Edge and experience Hollywood Studios' other premier attractions: Tower of Terror, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith, and Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular — a dramatic water, fire, and projection show featuring Mickey Mouse battling Disney villains. Reserve premium Fantasmic! Dining Package (dinner at Mama Melrose's Ristorante Italiano or Hollywood Brown Derby with guaranteed Fantasmic! reserved seating included). End the evening with a walk through the dazzling Hollywood Boulevard atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — a fully immersive Star Wars-themed quick-service restaurant serving creative, galactic-inspired breakfast items like Ronto Morning Wraps in the heart of Batuu
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge — the most exclusive bar/lounge in Hollywood Studios; enjoy exotic cocktails (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), unique Star Wars-themed snacks, and DJ R-3X spinning intergalactic beats (reservations highly recommended; limited to 45 minutes per group)
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby — Hollywood Studios' most upscale table-service restaurant; a replica of the legendary 1930s Hollywood eatery with sophisticated American cuisine, signature Cobb Salad prepared tableside, and an impressive wine list; book the Fantasmic! Dining Package for reserved show seating

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations open 60 days in advance for resort guests and sell out extremely fast — book the moment the reservation window opens at 7:00 AM EST. Oga's Cantina also requires reservations and has a 2-drink minimum per person. Lightning Lane Individual purchase for Rise of the Resistance is strongly recommended. Bring a bag to carry your lightsaber — Savi's provides a carrying case. June heat is intense; plan rest breaks in air-conditioned areas during 1–3 PM.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive using Early Theme Park Entry and go directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's most popular attraction — a breathtaking banshee riding simulator) before lines grow. Follow with Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning boat ride through a bioluminescent rainforest. Explore the lush Pandora landscape, interact with roving cast members in character, and discover the floating mountains and exotic flora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Kilimanjaro Safaris — board an open-air safari vehicle for a guided 18-minute expedition through 110 acres of authentic African savanna. Observe lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, rhinos, hippos, and hundreds of other animals in naturalistic habitats. After the safari, walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Experience Expedition Everest – Legend of the Forbidden Mountain and DINOSAUR. Attend the Festival of the Lion King live show — a Broadway-caliber performance.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings — as dusk falls, the iconic 145-foot Tree of Life comes alive with magical projection sequences showing animals awakening within its roots and branches. Attend Rivers of Light or the park's evening entertainment. Depart for a luxurious resort evening — enjoy the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront, pool area, or resort bar for a relaxing finale.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant — Animal Kingdom's most prestigious table-service restaurant; a sophisticated, art-filled dining room inspired by the journeys of Disney's Imagineers; serves globally-inspired cuisine with an exceptional wine and cocktail program; open for breakfast/brunch on select days
meals.lunch: Nomad Lounge (adjacent to Tiffins) — a relaxed, upscale lounge with creative cocktails, artisan small plates, and a beautiful outdoor terrace overlooking the Discovery River; perfect for a midday recharge
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant — return for a premium dinner experience with dishes such as whole-roasted sustainable fish, braised short rib, and signature desserts; one of Disney's finest culinary experiences with an award-winning wine list and impeccable service

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage consistently has the longest wait times in all of Disney World — arriving at rope drop via Early Theme Park Entry is essential, or purchase Lightning Lane Individual access. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (around 8–9 PM in June). The park is extraordinarily lush and immersive — allow extra time to explore trails and hidden details. Tiffins is one of Disney's most acclaimed restaurants; book 60 days in advance. Wear insect repellent in the outdoor areas.

day_by_day.morning: Final resort morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a leisurely beachfront breakfast and take full advantage of the luxury amenities you may not have had time for earlier in the week. Options include: a private cabana by the pool, a couples' or family spa treatment at the resort spa, a gentle kayak or paddleboard session on the resort's waterfront, or simply relaxing on the beach with a tropical cocktail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time: if departing evening or next day, consider a final visit to Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping and picking up any specialty items (Ghirardelli, Gideon's Bakehouse for famous cookies, or Disney-exclusive merchandise). Alternatively, enjoy a final swim, resort activities, or a leisurely lunch on the resort's waterfront terrace. Pack bags and complete resort checkout procedures. Arrange private luxury transfer to Orlando International Airport.
day_by_day.evening: Private luxury car transfer to Orlando International Airport. Enjoy the MCO lounges (Chase Sapphire, Amex Centurion, or airline premium lounges) before your flight. Reflect on an extraordinary week of Disney magic, world-class dining, and unforgettable family memories.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature waterfront restaurant — order the full luxury spread: eggs your way, smoked salmon, avocado toast, Belgian waffles, fresh tropical juices, and a final round of mimosas or specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Paddlefish at Disney Springs — a stunning multi-deck seafood restaurant aboard a permanently docked steamboat; enjoy fresh oysters, lobster bisque, and premium seafood dishes with beautiful waterfront views for a memorable final lunch
meals.dinner: Airport dining in the premium lounge, or an early dinner at Disney Springs' The BOATHOUSE — an upscale waterfront restaurant with USDA prime steaks, fresh seafood, and classic American fare with stunning marina views; perfect final Disney World meal

day_by_day.notes: Check resort checkout time (typically 11 AM) and request a late checkout if your flight departs in the evening — luxury resorts often accommodate this for premium guests. Store luggage with the bell desk if checkout precedes departure. Confirm private transfer booking 24 hours before. Allow at least 3 hours before departure for Orlando International Airport security and boarding, especially during peak summer travel season. Consider shipping large souvenir purchases home via the resort's shipping service to avoid baggage fees.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
